# Cycle Burn — No-Loss Lottery integration guide (for AI coding agents)

You are integrating the Cycle Burn No-Loss Lottery into an existing Internet
Computer (ICP) dapp. Everything happens by calling one public canister
directly — no SDK, no token, no bridge, and the integrating app is never in
the money path.

## What the feature does
Users lock ICP into pooled NNS neurons ("staking"). Staking is lossless: the
principal is never spent and always returns after the term's dissolve. Stakers
automatically receive free lottery tickets every day (server-side — no visit
or claim call required). Three times a week, when the pot holds ≥ 25 ICP and
at least 25 unique players hold tickets, an on-chain drawing pays 65% of the
pot to one winner (directly to their wallet), rolls 30% into the next pot, and
burns 5% to cycles.

## Essentials
- Lottery canister (mainnet): k7dn6-qiaaa-aaaap-qutha-cai
- ICP ledger: ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai
- All amounts are e8s (1 ICP = 100_000_000).
- CRITICAL TRUST RULE: every call is keyed to the CALLER's principal. Make all
  calls with the END USER's identity (their wallet / Internet Identity
  session). Never call from your backend or a proxy identity — a proxy would
  own every stake it creates.
- Queries are free and fast. stake/unstake are update calls (~2s consensus).

## Candid interface (the integration surface)
type StakeTier = variant { SixMonths; OneYear; TwoYears };
type Result = variant { Ok; Err : text };
type BalanceResult = variant { Ok : nat64; Err : text };
type LedgerAccount = record { owner : principal; subaccount : opt blob };
service : {
  get_stake_deposit_address : () -> (LedgerAccount) query;
  stake : (nat64, StakeTier) -> (Result);
  unstake : (nat64, StakeTier) -> (BalanceResult);
  get_my_stake : () -> (UserStakeInfo) query;
  get_lottery_info : () -> (LotteryInfo) query;
  get_my_ticket_breakdown : () -> (vec TicketSourceRow) query;
  list_recent_winners : () -> (vec LotteryDraw) query;
}

## agent-js idlFactory (paste-ready)
export const idlFactory = ({ IDL }) => {
  const StakeTier = IDL.Variant({ SixMonths: IDL.Null, OneYear: IDL.Null, TwoYears: IDL.Null });
  const Result = IDL.Variant({ Ok: IDL.Null, Err: IDL.Text });
  const BalanceResult = IDL.Variant({ Ok: IDL.Nat64, Err: IDL.Text });
  const LedgerAccount = IDL.Record({ owner: IDL.Principal, subaccount: IDL.Opt(IDL.Vec(IDL.Nat8)) });
  const LotteryInfo = IDL.Record({
    enabled: IDL.Bool, pot_e8s: IDL.Nat64, next_draw_at: IDL.Nat64,
    min_pot_e8s: IDL.Nat64, min_unique_holders: IDL.Nat64,
    my_tickets: IDL.Nat64, my_daily_tickets: IDL.Nat64, eligible: IDL.Bool,
    total_tickets: IDL.Nat64, unique_holders: IDL.Nat64, round: IDL.Nat64,
    draws_held: IDL.Nat64, total_paid_e8s: IDL.Nat64, tickets_per_day: IDL.Nat64,
    odds_denominator: IDL.Nat64, claimed_today: IDL.Bool, admin_excluded: IDL.Bool,
    last_win_at: IDL.Opt(IDL.Nat64), last_winner: IDL.Opt(IDL.Principal),
  });
  return IDL.Service({
    get_stake_deposit_address: IDL.Func([], [LedgerAccount], ['query']),
    stake: IDL.Func([IDL.Nat64, StakeTier], [Result], []),
    unstake: IDL.Func([IDL.Nat64, StakeTier], [BalanceResult], []),
    get_lottery_info: IDL.Func([], [LotteryInfo], ['query']),
  });
};

## Flow 1 — Stake (three calls; tickets start the same day)
1. const acct = await cycleBurn.get_stake_deposit_address();
2. await ledger.icrc1_transfer({ to: { owner: acct.owner, subaccount: acct.subaccount },
   amount, fee: [], memo: [], from_subaccount: [], created_at_time: [] });
   // transfer EXACTLY the amount you will pass to stake(); ledger fees are
   // covered by the protocol treasury. The transfer must land BEFORE step 3.
3. const res = await cycleBurn.stake(amount, { SixMonths: null });
   // Err variants are text codes. Tiers: SixMonths = 5 tickets/ICP/day,
   // OneYear = 10, TwoYears = 20. Minimum FIRST stake per tier: 1 ICP.

## Flow 2 — Read lottery state (drives your whole UI)
const info = await cycleBurn.get_lottery_info();
- info.pot_e8s: current jackpot (÷1e8 for ICP)
- info.next_draw_at: nanosecond timestamp of the next drawing (0 = unscheduled)
- info.my_tickets / info.my_daily_tickets / info.eligible: the caller's state
  (authenticated calls only; anonymous callers get public fields)
- info.min_pot_e8s / info.min_unique_holders: the two draw gates
Also: get_my_stake() (per-tier positions), get_my_ticket_breakdown() (ticket
sources), list_recent_winners() (winners feed).

## Flow 3 — Unstake (the exit is always open)
const out = await cycleBurn.unstake(amount, { SixMonths: null });
- Ok is a pending-unstake id. The ICP pays out AUTOMATICALLY to the user once
  the tier's neuron finishes dissolving (6mo/1y/2y). Nothing to claim.
- Tickets void only when the user's LAST stake empties; partial unstakes keep
  the remainder earning.

## Rules your UI should reflect
- Tickets are stakers-only and land automatically every day — no visit or
  claim call needed. Show my_daily_tickets as the user's daily earn rate.
- Winners are paid automatically to their own wallet: 65% winner / 30% next
  pot / 5% burned. The integrating app never touches prize money.
- Drawings run Mon/Wed/Sat nights (US Eastern) only when both gates are met;
  otherwise the pot rolls over and keeps growing.
- Live docs for humans: https://kyclk-5qaaa-aaaap-quthq-cai.icp0.io/#/dev-docs
